description: This circular walk explores Bagley Wood in the Oxfordshire village of Kennington. The village is located a few miles south of Oxford with the woods to the west of the village. In the ancient woods you'll find miles of trails taking you through the peaceful oak woodland. In the springtime you can also see lots of pretty bluebells with more wildflowers appearing throughout the summer. On the way look out for a variety of woodland birds and other wildlife. To extend the walk head east to pick up the Thames Path and enjoy a riverside walk around the pretty village of Sandford on Thames .
